segments.comment: Valid independent selected-location recipe for pager.c do_look. The two spaces acknowledge the quick-look prompt and first-use cursor tip, then . selects the blind hero square. The JavaScript do_look quick guard now matches C: it skips checkfile while preserving the description and message-window cleanup; tty_putmixed itself can wait through tty_putstr/update_topl and was not the cause of the former extra --More--.
